assumptions.text: Solid product ('board' family): moulded-shell checks (draft, undercut, wall thickness, clamp tonnage) do not apply; the measured checks are process fit, stock size and thinnest section on the product CAD
assumptions.label: estimate

issues.description: The traction pad is specified as a part but is missing from the BOM, along with its attachment method. The factory cannot procure or install it consistently.
issues.fix: Add the EVA pad and a specified marine-grade pressure-sensitive adhesive or pre-applied adhesive backing to the BOM; define its placement.
issues.rule_citation: Define all purchased parts and joining methods in the BOM and assembly instructions — ISO 10007 configuration management guidance.

issues.description: The laminate specification omits cloth weight, ply count, layup locations, and resin cure instructions. Strength, weight, and finish will vary between builds.
issues.fix: Issue a laminate schedule for the deck, bottom, and rails, plus resin mix, cure, and finishing instructions.
issues.rule_citation: Specify reinforcement architecture and processing for composite manufacture — Gurit Guide to Composites.

issues.description: Fin boxes and the leash plug are in the BOM, but their models, routing dimensions, installation method, and alignment datums are unspecified. Supplied fins may not fit the boxes.
issues.fix: Specify a compatible fin-and-box system, plug model, routing templates, installation materials, and locations referenced to board datums.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating interfaces and assembly datums — ASME Y14.5 dimensioning and tolerancing.

issues.description: Solid product (60.2 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: hand / CNC shaping of a foam blank + hand lamination.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Solid volume of all parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Board length 2286 mm (7.5 ft) fits standard PU blank stock (up to 9'0" / 2745 mm).
issues.fix: Order the next blank size up with the right rocker; keep 20-30 mm shaping allowance.
issues.rule_citation: Blank sizes of the major foam suppliers (6'0" to 9'0" shortboard/mid-length ranges) — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Overall length, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Maximum hull thickness 72 mm (with rocker the bbox is taller): enough float for the brief.
issues.fix: Keep ≥ 65 mm at the centre for beginners; move volume under the chest, not into the rails.
issues.rule_citation: Surf shaping rule of thumb: beginner mid-lengths 65-80 mm thick — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Smallest extent of the hull, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: The spec does not say whether outline, thickness, rocker, and fin-box tolerances apply before or after lamination and gloss polishing. Finish build-up makes inspection ambiguous.
issues.fix: Define inspection at the finished-board stage, with measurement datums and rocker support conditions; set separate blank-shaping targets if needed.
issues.rule_citation: Define the measured feature and datum reference for dimensional inspection — ASME Y14.5 dimensioning and tolerancing.

issues.description: Gloss polish is not an appropriate finish instruction for an EVA traction pad: it could remove the intended grip texture.
issues.fix: Specify the EVA texture, colour, and edge treatment; limit gloss polishing to the laminated board.
issues.rule_citation: Specify surface finish by functional surface and material — ISO 1302 indication of surface texture.

certifications.standard: General Product Safety (GPSR 2023/988 EU; CPSA US)
certifications.applies_because: No electronics, battery, food-contact or children's-product trigger found: general product-safety duties still apply (technical file, labelling, traceability)
